reasons: Cited text (21.1–21.4) matches the preferred position: mutual aggregate cap at the greater of 12 months' Fees 'paid or payable' and USD 1,000,000, mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages, and an Excluded Claims definition covering confidentiality, data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP.

Resolved 'Fees' definition (§1.5) covers recurring subscription, professional services and usage fees, so the cap base is meaningful rather than illusory; 21.3 also confirms Customer's undisputed payment obligations are not 'damages'.
No one-sided or hidden cap identified; deterministic checks (12-month/fixed-floor basis; no unlimited Customer liability) both pass.
Consistent with a compliant status, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed — appropriate as internal evidence rather than a negotiation issue.
